messages:
Ava (CEO): quick follow-up from today's all-hands — i'm on here for 20m to field short Qs about mission, market stance, and competitor positioning. shoot concise questions pls :sparkles:
Zoe (Sales): for sales collateral, should we lean into 'platform' or 'runtime' messaging? leads ask both.
Maya (Head of Strategy): platform first — teams buy a solution to run models reliably. runtime is an important technical proof point for eng buyers.
Chris (VP Product): can we have a 1-liner that is non-technical for marketing? current mission reads a bit infra-heavy.
Maya (Head of Strategy): try: "Redwood helps engineering teams run LLMs in production with predictable performance, lower costs, and enterprise controls." clean + customer-facing.
Ravi (Eng): on the runtime side: are we committing to multi-cloud region failover for Hosted? customers want regional resilience.
Ava (CEO): yes — multi-region failover is in the roadmap for Hosted GA. priority is consistent latency + automated fallback.
Zoe (Sales): competitive objection: "Why not just use BigCloud endpoints?" what's the short reply?
Maya (Head of Strategy): short: "We give you predictable economics, rollout controls, and observability for production LLMs — things BigCloud doesn't productize today."
Chris (VP Product): also call out Optimize: quantization recommendations and batching suggestions that reduce unit costs — that sells well into finance teams.
Ravi (Eng): technical quickie: will Private support customer-provided KMS on day one?
Ava (CEO): yes, customer KMS/HSM integrations are scoped for the Private GA. it's a blocker for regulated customers so prioritized.
PatchBot: note: all-hands summary posted to docs at 1766032150 by PatchBot
Zoe (Sales): can we get a short battlecard text for sales to use in CTAs? 1-2 sentences.
Maya (Head of Strategy): "Redwood Inference: a production-first platform to run LLMs with predictable latency, lower per-token costs, and enterprise controls across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments." use as-is.
Ava (CEO): i'll push that to marketing and sales. thanks all 10 — if you want deeper dives, book with maya/chris.
